svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Latency surface 3D: checkout request-duration histogram
svg.desc: 3D latency surface for the checkout service during INC-2041: X = time 11:50–12:40, Z = latency bucket on a log scale from 1 ms to 10 s, Y = requests per second in the bucket. The mesh is lit from the upper left and coloured by height on a perceptual ramp, with contour lines and a faint wireframe. The normal ridge near 120 ms drops after 12:22 while a sharp ridge rises in the 2 s timeout bucket (psp-api client timeout set at 12:19), with a Failing bloom. The selected column (12:31) and row (le 2 s) glow on the surface and drive two linked 2D slice charts: the distribution at 12:31 as a bar histogram and the 2 s bucket over time as a line. HUD: colour legend linked to contours, camera presets, orbit gizmo, data badge, coverage meter and per-axis zoom hint.
